title: Collection tree editing
brief: Editing the collection tree: context menu on a request and on a folder, inline rename, duplicate, delete confirmation naming how many requests a folder holds, drag to move with a drop target, new request and new folder. Built on the bolt-v2 shell.

artboards.title: Context menu, inline rename, modal delete
artboards.tradeoff: Desktop-standard and discoverable by right-click, with a modal that lists what a delete removes; actions stay hidden until right-click and every delete costs a modal

artboards.title: Hover actions, inline confirmation, drag to reorder
artboards.tradeoff: Actions visible on hover and confirmation without leaving the tree, fast for one-off edits; denser rows, and the inline confirm has less room to list affected requests

artboards.title: Organize document with bulk actions
artboards.tradeoff: Safe bulk moves and deletes with file paths visible and a destination picker; a separate mode, slower for a single quick rename
